purpose: Layer B ledger for report_drc. Any Error/Critical Warning is Layer A and cannot appear here as acceptable. Every Warning/Advisory rule present in the round's drc.rpt must be named by exactly one entry below, with the instances it was found in; a new rule, a changed severity, or a violation outside the reviewed instances fails the gate.
notes: Severity is asserted, not assumed: the entry records the severity the review was written against and the gate fails if the report says otherwise.
instance_prefixes is a structural allow-list, not a text filter: violations of the same rule in any other subtree fail.

optional: true means the rule may legitimately be absent in another design shape; absence is still printed in the ledger, presence must still be reviewed. It never weakens the check on a finding that IS present.

items.structure: DSP48E2 input registers (A/B/C ports) of the colour-space conversion arithmetic (u_rx_csc/pixel*, u_ps_capture/u_csc, u_ps_capture/u_tap), the DMA byte/word accumulators (u_dma_top/u_sg_dma_engine/h2c_p0_bytes_q*, u_dma_top/u_thin_desc_fetch_engine/target_uv0|target_y) and the vendor DRU inside u_vid_phy_controller.
items.rationale: Performance advice on datapaths that are not clock-critical: the CSC taps and the byte counters are read after a pixel group or a transfer completes, so an extra pipeline stage is functionally free and there is no timing failure to fix (Layer A owns WNS/WHS/TNS). Nothing in this rule implies a correctness defect, and the vid_phy rows are vendor content that cannot be re-coded here.
evidence: build/evidence-dcpio-26111106/rpt/drc.rpt (74 DPIP-2 rows: u_rx_csc 36, u_ps_capture/u_csc 24, u_dma_top 6, u_vid_phy_controller 6, u_ps_capture/u_tap 2)
rtl/custom_pcie_dma_top.v (byte accumulator RTL), rtl/zu4ev_pcie_card_top.v:1054 video_rgb_to_yuv709 u_rx_csc, rtl/sc7f0_capture_pipeline.v:71 sc7f0_vpss_csc u_csc

items.structure: Same DSP48 population as DPIP-2 with PREG=0.
items.rationale: Output-pipelining advice, same non-critical accumulator datapath. Accepting it means one extra cycle of read latency on a counter nobody times.
evidence: build/evidence-dcpio-26111106/rpt/drc.rpt (13 DPOP-3 rows: u_rx_csc/pixel* and u_dma_top/u_thin_desc_fetch_engine)

items.rationale: Multiplier-pipelining advice; same reasoning as DPOP-3.
evidence: build/evidence-dcpio-26111106/rpt/drc.rpt (30 DPOP-4 rows: u_ps_capture/u_csc, u_vid_phy_controller DRU, u_dma_top, u_ps_capture/u_tap)

items.structure: Physical LUT pin connected but absent from the LUT equation, generated by the AXI protocol converters / FIFO flag logic during synthesis.
items.rationale: Cosmetic netlist artefact of inferred LUT packing: the unused pin cannot affect function because it is not in the INIT equation. Vivado's own text says to regenerate/resynthesise to clear it; it is not a connectivity loss (that is RTSTAT-10, which is reviewed separately and is NOT accepted here).
evidence: build/evidence-dcpio-26111106/rpt/drc.rpt (3 rows, all inside axi_downsizer fifo flag LUTs)

items.structure: XPM FIFO SDP-mode BRAM instantiated with NO_CHANGE write mode.
items.rationale: AMD's recommended low-power write mode for xpm_fifo. An address collision requires the read and write ports to present the same address, which the FIFO controller prevents: a read is only issued when the Gray-synchronised empty flag is clear and a write only when full is clear, so the two pointers differ. The same structure is used by every shipped generation and by the FIFO generator itself.
evidence: build/evidence-dcpio-26111106/rpt/drc.rpt (2 rows, both xpm_memory_base_inst inside u_dma_top FIFOs)

items.structure: 34 nets with no routable loads in the routed netlist, e.g. u_hdmi_rx_ss/inst/v_hdmi_rx/inst/SYS_INST/lclk_cke[3] and several axi_downsizer FIFO flag nets (aempty_fwft_i, gwss.wsts/ram_afull_fb).
items.rationale: A net with no loads is usually trimmed logic, but it can equally be a dropped connection: lclk_cke[3] disappearing inside the vendor RX subsystem is exactly the class of thing that must be root-caused rather than waved through, and this round has no per-net evidence.
items.missing_evidence: Per-net answer for the 34 names: report_net / get_fanout on each, showing either 'drives nothing by construction (unused IP lane)' or the missing consumer. Minimal next step: one bounded query over the net list printed by report_drc, no full re-implementation.
evidence: build/evidence-dcpio-26111106/rpt/drc.rpt RTSTAT-10#1 (the 34 net names are listed in the violation text)
